2. Vimada is mentioned in several passages of the Rigveda as a protégé of the Aśvins, who gave him a wife, kamadyū. His identity with the preceding is improbable.
Foot notes i. 51, 3; 112, 19; 116, 1; 117, 20; x. 39, 7; 65, 12, From viii. 9, 15, Ludwig, Translation of the Rigveda, 3, 105, has inferred that vimada and vatsa were identical.
